findings.evidence: `def withLpProdCongr (f : α ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] α') (g : β ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] β') : WithLp p (α × β) ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] WithLp p (α' × β')` at mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Lp/ProdLp.lean:1197, and `theorem LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map (f : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] E') (x y : E) : ⟪f x, f y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫` at mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/LinearMap.lean:117 — the same lemma the sibling file already uses (TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/Riemannian/Isometry/Euclidean.lean:85). The rotation part is exactly the O(n-1) piece of the point stabilizer the PR description defers as future work, and it specializes back to the current maps at `A = .refl`.
findings.fix: Add a parameter `(A : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)` and define the underlying map as `c • (LinearIsometryEquiv.withLpProdCongr 2 A (.refl ℝ ℝ)) x + WithLp.toLp 2 (b, 0)`. `height_similarityMap` is unchanged (the second component is untouched); `inner_mfderiv'` closes by `LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map` after `real_inner_smul_left/right`; the composition law becomes `(c * c', A.trans A', c • A b' + b)` and the inverse `(c⁻¹, A.symm, -(c⁻¹ • A.symm b))`. `isPretransitive_isom` then instantiates at `A = .refl`.
findings.issue: `similarity c hc b : (x, t) ↦ (c • x + b, c • t)` is the `A = id` special case of the natural family of similarities of the half-space fixing ∞, `(x, t) ↦ (c • A x + b, c • t)` for `A : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E`. Every lemma in the group carries the restricted parameter shape — `coe_similarity_apply` (392), `height_similarity_apply` (399), `tangentSpaceCastModel_mfderiv_similarity` (404), `similarity_one` (414), `similarity_mul_similarity` (420), `similarity_inv` (429), plus the private block `similarityMap`/`coe_similarityMap`/`height_similarityMap`/`similarityMap_similarityMap`/`similarityMap_eq_self`/`similarityMap_inv_similarityMap`/`similarityMap_similarityMap_inv`/`contMDiff_similarityMap`/`tangentSpaceCastModel_mfderiv_similarityMap` (228-286) — so adding `A` later rewrites all of their signatures.

summary: The base-space generality (arbitrary real inner product space E) and the placement of `rescale` at Mathlib's vector-bundle level are right, and the prior `InnerProductSpace`-too-early finding is fixed. The `similarity` family is under-general: it omits the orthogonal factor, which is available at no extra cost and is part of the standard notion the name claims.
